name: HeritageOak
description:
============================================================================
A-009 Stress Test — 2026-05-08
"Wayfinder's Garden"

NEVER-EXERCISED TRAITS UNDER TEST:
@gesture             — GestureConfig full exercise: all six gesture types
(swipe_left, swipe_right, swipe_up, swipe_down,
pinch, palm_open). Pinch activates plant info panels.
Swipe-up advances the navigation trail. Palm-open
dismisses any overlaid waypoint. Also exercises
debounce (300 ms) and pinchThreshold (0.85).
@spatial_audio_cue   — Four cue_types in one scene: 'navigation' (path
breadcrumb chimes), 'information' (plant specimen
earcon), 'confirmation' (waypoint reached), and
'alert' (rare-orchid proximity ring). Exercises
spatial:true, repeat_interval, max_distance, and
the TTS message path for accessibility.
@spatial_navigation  — holographic PathVisualization in 'walking' mode.
Exercises show_distance, show_eta, auto_recalculate
(1.5 m threshold), waypoint_radius_m, and custom
path_color. Tests the four-waypoint trail from
the Gate through Oak Glade → Fern Valley → Orchid
Terrace → Observatory Bench.
@co_located          — cloud_anchor alignment for two simultaneous
visitors. shared_anchor_id pinned to the Heritage
Oak. max_participants:4, auto_align:true.
realignment_threshold:0.25 m (tight — garden paths
are narrow). Exercises the visual_indicator flag
that shows the shared-world ring at the anchor.

WELL-EXERCISED ANCHORS:
@anchor     — all plant specimen markers are world-locked spatial anchors
@animated   — flower bloom response when pinch gesture is detected
@hoverable  — information panels fade in on hover, fade out on leave
@accessible — TTS labels on every named specimen; role: "landmark"

SCENE STORY:
The Wellington Botanical Reserve has an AR trail system. Two visitors —
call them V1 (south entrance) and V2 (north entrance) — open the trail
app simultaneously. Their AR sessions align to a cloud anchor on the
400-year-old Heritage Oak at the centre of the reserve. Once aligned,
they share the same virtual layer: glowing path breadcrumbs on the gravel,
soft chimes when they approach labelled specimens, plant information
panels that bloom open at a pinch gesture.

The trail has four waypoints. A spatial navigation overlay (holographic,
soft green) shows each visitor their remaining distance and ETA. When
both visitors reach the Observatory Bench, the shared session plays a
confirmation chime — the only sound that emanates from both headsets
simultaneously.

The rare orchid — Pterostylis banksii, the greenhood — triggers an alert
cue at 3 m radius. The earcon is a single clear bell tone; the TTS message
reads its Māori name, "perei", for visitors using voice navigation.
============================================================================

ThrowableBreakableObject
description:
Physics Object Lifecycle — .hsplus Behavior Example

Demonstrates the combined @throwable, @breakable, and @stackable
physics traits in a gameplay-oriented scenario.
WHY .hsplus: A throwable object's lifecycle (idle -> grabbed -> aimed
-> thrown -> flying -> impact -> broken/landed -> cooldown -> reset)
is a classic reactive state machine driven by physics events (grab,
release, collision) with computed transitions (break if impact force
exceeds threshold, land if below). Continuous velocity tracking in
@on_update plus discrete collision events in @on_collision cannot
be expressed in .holo (static) or .hs (no per-frame hooks).

Features:
- PhysicsTracker module for velocity, angular velocity, impact force
- ThrowableBreakableObject template with full lifecycle state machine
- @throwable + @breakable + @stackable combined on single objects
- @on_collision for impact detection and break threshold evaluation
- Scoring module for gameplay integration
- Multiple objects with different break thresholds and materials

name: Camera
ParticleControlsPanel
description:
Million-Particle GPU System

High-performance particle simulation with GPU-accelerated sorting,
spatial hashing, and collision detection. Demonstrates scalability
of WebGPU compute shaders to 1M+ particles @ 60 FPS.

Features:
- 1,048,576 particles (2^20)
- GPU radix sort for depth sorting (transparent particles)
- Spatial hash grid for O(n) collision detection
- Parallel collision response with atomic operations
- Instanced rendering with GPU culling

Performance Pipeline:
[1] Integrate forces (gravity, wind) - 0.8ms
[2] Build spatial hash grid - 1.2ms
[3] Collide particles via grid - 2.5ms
[4] Sort particles by depth - 3.8ms (radix sort)
[5] Frustum cull invisible particles - 0.4ms
[6] Render visible instances - 1.9ms
Total: ~10.6ms @ 94 FPS (RTX 3080)

Scientific Use Cases:
- Molecular dynamics (drug discovery)
- Astrophysical N-body simulation (galaxies)
- Crowd simulation (urban planning)
- Granular material physics (sand, gravel)

@version 7.0.0
@category High-Performance Computing

name: PhysicsControlsPanel
description:
GPU Rigid Body Physics Simulation

Parallel rigid body dynamics with impulse-based collision resolution.
This example uses the current .holo grammar: constants live in state,
WebGPU kernels are declared as shader metadata blocks, and simulation
work is exposed through event-driven logic handlers.

Features:
- 10,000 rigid bodies at 60 Hz
- 6-DOF dynamics with quaternion orientation
- Spatial-hash broad phase plus sphere narrow phase
- Sequential impulse solver with friction and restitution
- Instanced WebGPU rendering from the rigid-body buffer

@version 5.2.1
@category Physics Simulation

name: ReconstructionPanel
description:
HoloShell Legacy App Reconstruction Room

Visible room concept for:
"Convert a captured legacy application window into a dense HoloScript scene
of 1000+ geometry nodes with semantic control groups, screenshot/OCR witness
placeholders, confidence metadata, and low-confidence execution blocks — where
the shell can inspect controls without exposing raw screenshots as the primary model."

The reconstruction replaces the opaque pixel surface of a legacy app with a
navigable, inspectable, semantically rich HoloScript geometry. Raw screenshots
are evidence anchors (available on demand), never the primary model.

template "PermissionGateReceiptContract" {

  }

name: BrittneyAgent
description:
============================================================================
Glass Cathedral — 500,000 Floating Shards Catching Light
============================================================================
A gothic cathedral built not from stone but from suspended glass.
Every surface is dissolved into hundreds of thousands of translucent
fragments — each one a tiny prism refracting light at its own angle.
Where walls should be solid, shards cluster dense. Where windows
should open, they thin to nothing, letting god-rays pierce through.
The whole structure breathes: shards drift on imperceptible currents,
never quite still, never quite the same twice.
============================================================================

name: OracleAgent
description:
============================================================================
Mycelium Network — 1.2 Million Bioluminescent Threads
============================================================================
The underground internet of the forest, made visible. A vast fungal network
rendered as luminous threads connecting nodes of concentrated energy.
Each node pulses with slow metabolic rhythm. Threads carry light-packets
between nodes — information traveling through living wire. The whole
system grows: new hyphae extend outward, branching fractally, probing
the dark for nutrients. Some paths strengthen and glow brighter as they
carry more traffic. Others atrophy, dimming to nothing.

This is not a static sculpture. It is a simulation of emergence —
intelligence arising from simple rules at massive scale.
============================================================================

name: AbsorbAgent
description:
============================================================================
Orbital Loom — 820,000 Luminous Threads Weaving Spacetime
============================================================================
A cosmic weaving machine suspended in the void. Thousands of orbital
filaments trace elliptical paths around a gravitational singularity,
each thread a different eccentricity, inclination, and color. Where
orbits intersect, bright knots of tangled light accumulate — emergent
fabric forming from pure kinematics.

The central attractor is not a star but an absence — a dark sphere
that bends light around it, visible only by what it distorts. Around
it, concentric shells of orbiting threads create interference patterns
that look like woven cloth seen from impossible angles.

At the periphery, threads escape — flung outward by gravitational
slingshot, trailing luminous tails into the dark. These are the frayed
edges of the cosmic tapestry, unraveling into infinity.

This is gravity as a loom. Orbits as thread. Intersection as weave.
============================================================================

name: joint1
description:
Isaac Lab Sim-to-Real Example
Demonstrates Path A: HoloScript -> Isaac Lab asset/export
Features:
- PhysicsDriveAPI for PD actuator control
- PhysxJointAxisAPI for per-axis joint friction assumptions
- Domain randomization configuration
- Delayed actuator metadata for communication latency
snippet:
object "joint1" {
    @joint_revolute
    joint_parent: "base_link"
    joint_origin: [0, 0, 0.05]
    joint_axis: [0, 0, 1]
    joint_limits: [-3.14, 3.14]
    joint_effort: 50
    max_velocity: 3.14
    // PD gains for Isaac Lab drive control
    kp: 100.0
    kd: 10.0
    // Joint friction (sim-to-real)
    joint_friction: 0.05
    joint_viscous_friction: 0.01
    armature: 0.001
    // Actuator latency for DelayedPDActuator
    actuator_latency: 0.005
    actuator_group: {
      name: "arm_group"
      type: "DelayedPDActuator"
      joints: ["joint1", "joint2"]
      stiffness: 100
      damping: 10
      friction: 0.05
      latency: 0.005
    }
  }

name: GameLobby
description:
Multiplayer Arena Game — Refreshed (A-009 refresh 2026-05-25)

Original intent: a networked 2-player arena where each player grabs a ball
and tries to throw it through the opponent's goal.

Refresh adds:
@lobby          — pre-game lobby with skill-based matchmaking and a 10-second
countdown before play begins. Exercises zero-coverage trait.
@networked_avatar — each spawn point hosts a synchronized avatar with full
skeletal IK — hands follow tracked controllers. Zero-coverage.
@haptic         — GameBall triggers controller rumble on grab and on goal impact.
@state_machine  — Arena transitions: Lobby → Countdown → Playing → Scored → End.
@particle       — goal rings emit a burst of team-colored sparks on score.

Scene story: a compact hexagonal arena suspended in void. Two players materialize
at their glowing spawn discs — blue and orange. Before the timer hits zero, avatars
can wave their hands; IK bones follow tracked controllers in real time. Kick-off:
the ball drops center. On impact with the net the goal ring detonates in sparks and
the arena state machine advances to Scored, pausing physics for two seconds before
the next serve. Controller haptics confirm every catch and every score.

name: CeilingRing
description:
The Cartographer's Table (A-009 stress-test 2026-05-25)

Exercises two zero-coverage trait combinations:
@world_generator    — generates 3D island geometry from text prompts via the
sovereign-3d engine; outputs Gaussian splat + mesh pair.
@screen_space_effects — full SSR + SSAO + film grain + depth-of-field stack
applied to the obsidian chamber.

Combined with well-exercised traits:
@glowing            — cartographic interface panels and island frames
@animated           — table surface pulses as generation runs
@particle           — data-dust scatters as each island crystallizes
@physics            — generated island chunks obey gravity, can shatter
@bloom_reactive     — bloom spikes at generation completion event

Scene story: a circular obsidian chamber, forty meters across. In the center
stands a low hexagonal table — the Cartographer's Table — ringed by six hovering
input panels. An operator presses a rune on panel three and speaks a biome:
"volcanic archipelago, low tide, active vents." The table surface blooms white.
Data-dust rises in a slow vortex — particles of shredded 3D Gaussian data,
recycled from the last generation run. Then the first island emerges: a basalt
stack four meters tall, steaming at the waterline, surrounded by smaller islets.
Each island floats at eye level. The operator can reach in and shatter one against
the table edge — physics fragments scatter, then the table absorbs them back into
the next prompt.

The chamber floor is polished black obsidian. SSR reflects the floating islands
perfectly. SSAO deepens the cracks between basalt columns. Depth of field pulls
the distant chamber wall soft, focusing the eye on the islands. Film grain recalls
the linen texture of early cartography.
snippet:
object "CeilingRing" {
    type: "ring_light"
    position: [0, 18, 0]
    inner_radius: 12.0
    outer_radius: 14.0
    color: "#6040c8"
    intensity: 0.6
  }

name: HumanSteward
description:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
GOLD GAME — Gate 0 canonical skeleton (WORKING CONCEPT, NOT A BRAND NAME)

"Oasis Shard Zero": a persistent shared world where people and REAL agents
play together. Built on the existing frontier-shard-zero seam
(packages/hololand-platform/src/world/frontier-shard-zero.ts) — the Oasis
Market square. NPCs are real agents (JEPA-driven, $0.50/day-budgeted,
memory- and reputation-bearing); humans inhabit the same kind of entity.

AI<->HUMAN CONNECTION (load-bearing, not bolted on):

description:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
GOLD GAME — Gate 0 canonical skeleton (WORKING CONCEPT, NOT A BRAND NAME)

"Oasis Shard Zero": a persistent shared world where people and REAL agents
play together. Built on the existing frontier-shard-zero seam
(packages/hololand-platform/src/world/frontier-shard-zero.ts) — the Oasis
Market square. NPCs are real agents (JEPA-driven, $0.50/day-budgeted,
memory- and reputation-bearing); humans inhabit the same kind of entity.

AI<->HUMAN CONNECTION (load-bearing, not bolted on):
- One shared entity kind, two inhabitation paths:
* human  -> @controllable (ControllerInput / Voice projection)
* agent  -> @ai_agent     (AINPCBrain + JEPA loop + 6 sovereign traits)
- Shared world state (this composition's environment + zones)
- Shared relational mechanics (the Oasis Steward NPC tracks reputation)
- Common receipt spine (every action -> SimulationContract; AI actions also
emit WorldModelReceipt). Receipt wiring is proven at later gates; this
gate proves the .holo PARSES clean against @holoscript/core.

Naming/branding the flagship is a FOUNDER call — "Oasis Shard Zero" here is a
working concept derived from the existing shard, not a ratified product name.

Compile loop (fastest): R3F or Babylon. Gate 0 acceptance = parses clean.

name: HumanCurator
description:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
THE GOLD GAME — Gate 0 canonical skeleton (FOUNDER-RATIFIED CONCEPT 2026-05-22)

The flagship is the REAL GOLD knowledge-curation system (D:/GOLD) turned into
a GAME the founder plays, while the SAME system is enhanced for the agents/AI
who use it. Professional-system-as-game (the HoloLand/HoloShell pattern):
the human plays; the AI runs the real vault underneath.

REAL BACKEND  ⇄  GAME FACE (human)        ⇄  AGENT ENHANCEMENT
tiers bronze→diamond  →  ascending regions you climb   →  visible progression
graduate.py           →  THE CORE VERB: shepherd an     →  cleaner graduation
entry up the tiers                workflow
auto_link / lineage   →  forge the constellation of     →  richer retrieval
links between entries             graph
vault_collision_guard →  conflicts to resolve (monsters)→  de-duped vault
agents curating       →  real-agent co-players          →  game-shaped curation

HONEST MAPPING IS THE PRODUCT: a play-action IS a real vault op (graduating an
entry in-game graduates it for real). Reads the REAL vault as content; never
fakes vault state. Writing back to D:/GOLD stays governance-gated.

Seeded with real vault entries (INDEX.md): P.GOLD.001 (Diamond), W.GOLD.535,
W.GOLD.534, B.GRADUATE.001 (Bronze). Tier reality per `farm.py status`.

DEPLOYMENT (founder-ratified): compiles to a self-contained static web build
(R3F → index.html) destined for the D: Drive so it opens on any machine with
no install. Engine target = r3f; packaging target = portable Drive build.

AI<->HUMAN CONNECTION (load-bearing): one CURATOR entity kind, two inhabitation
paths (human @controllable / agent @ai_agent) acting on the SAME real vault.

Gate 0 acceptance = parses clean against @holoscript/core. Branding is a
FOUNDER call — "The Vault" here is a working concept, not a ratified name.

name: Research_Floor
description:
=============================================================================
VR Agent Motivation Visualizer
=============================================================================
Real-time display of active reward signals per agent in a multi-agent
HoloLand world. Each agent has a floating sphere showing motivation state:
- Position: X = intrinsic motivation, Y = social motivation, Z = task motivation
- Color: blended gradient reflecting reward signal strength (dim=low, bright=high)
- Ring size: confidence / belief update magnitude
- Animated "flow" particles: reward gradient descent trajectory
- Heartbeat beacon: agent presence + communication link

Use case: AI researchers visualizing emergent multi-agent motivation in
collaborative VR environments. Real-time binding to agent observation streams.
=============================================================================
